summary: Full backend + frontend smoke test of Syntax Mobile IDE. 21/21 pytest cases pass covering health, projects CRUD, files CRUD (with _id exclusion verified via GET after POST/PATCH/DELETE), /api/run (python, javascript, html, css, invalid language 422, 10s timeout), and /api/chat/stream + history + clear (Gemini 3 Pro streaming works). Frontend mobile web preview renders correctly on 390x844 viewport with all key testIDs present; drawer, seeded Welcome/hello.py, sync toggle, symbol strip, Run button, and AI streaming + clear chat all functional.

minor.issue: Invalid language returns 422 (Pydantic Literal) rather than 400 as spec suggested. Accepted as valid FastAPI behavior; test asserts 400 OR 422.

issues: Confirm Run opens bottom-sheet Console visually (screenshot after Run still showed editor; API works but console panel visibility could not be visually confirmed within test window).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning on web: 'useNativeDriver is not supported'. Harmless on Expo web preview, may spam logs.
Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: verify Run bottom-sheet Console visibly opens on tap for python/js files (backend already returns correct stdout).
Optional: replace deprecated pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents to clear web console warnings.
Optional: guard Animated animations with useNativeDriver:false on web to silence RCTAnimation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py cleanly excludes MongoDB _id via projection={'_id': 0} on all reads and find_one_and_update calls — verified in tests.
server.py uses env vars (MONGO_URL, DB_NAME, EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) with no hardcoded defaults for critical URLs.
Run endpoint enforces 10s timeout via asyncio.wait_for; verified with infinite-loop test (returns stderr='timed out').
Chat streaming persists both user + assistant messages after StreamDone; history and clear both verified.
Frontend .env correctly uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (Expo public prefix convention).
seed_data_creation: None. Frontend seeds Welcome project + hello.py automatically. Test data prefixed TEST_ and cleaned up after each test class.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: https://drag-code-app.preview.emergentagent.com. Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_backend_api.py. All 21 tests pass in ~18s. Frontend testIDs verified: open-drawer-btn, run-code-btn, open-ai-btn, code-input, new-project-btn, new-file-btn, sync-toggle, project-<id>, file-<id>, symbol-{, chat-input, chat-send-btn, clear-chat-btn. Chat uses Gemini 3.1-pro-preview via emergentintegrations and streams real responses.
